title: Federation over Text: Insight Sharing for Multi-Agent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2604.16778v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern agents specialize in varying domains while there is no clear approach combining different domain skills. We propose a federated learning-like framework, Federation over Text (FoT), that enables multiple clients solving different tasks to collectively generate a shared library of metacognitive insights by iteratively federating their local reasoning processes without sharing actual problem instances. Instead of federation over gradients (e.g., as in distributed training), FoT operates at the semantic level without any gradient optimization or supervision signal. At each round, client LLM agents independently apply arbitrary local reasoning and self-improvement procedures to their own tasks and share the resulting reasoning traces with a central server. translated_title: 文本之上的联邦：面向多智能体推理的洞察共享
translated_abstract: 现代智能体各自专注于不同的领域，但尚无明确的方法将不同领域的技能结合起来。我们提出了一种类似联邦学习的框架——文本联邦（Federation over Text, FoT），它使解决不同任务的多个客户端能够通过迭代式地联邦各自的本地推理过程，共同生成一个共享的元认知洞察库，而无需共享实际的问题实例。FoT 不是在梯度上进行联邦（例如像分布式训练那样），而是在语义层面运作，不涉及任何梯度优化或监督信号。在每一轮中，客户端大语言模型智能体独立地对各自的任务应用任意的本地推理和自我改进流程，并将由此产生的推理轨迹共享给中央服务器。随后，服务器将跨任务、跨领域的知识进行聚合、提炼与整合，形成一个共享的洞察库，供当前和未来的智能体复用。
tldr: 提出了一种类似联邦学习的“文本联邦”框架，使解决不同任务的大模型智能体无需共享问题实例、也无需梯度优化，仅通过在语义层面联邦各自的推理过程，就能共同构建一个可供现在和未来智能体复用的元认知洞察库。
en_tdlr: FoT is a federated learning-like framework that enables LLM agents solving different tasks to collectively build a reusable library of metacognitive insights by federating their local reasoning traces at the semantic level—without sharing problem instances or using any gradient optimization.
